I posted the draft as a reply in #strategic-random, so Nadia and Ruth can also see it. It has three figures:

- **First report:** 08:12 on Aug 3, from the SUP-5380 ticket log ("drivers queueing"). The incident room's first message is at 10:42, so the ticket time is the earlier report.
- **Kiosk 1 back:** 11:03 AM (trailer 8836 checked in).
- **Both lanes confirmed working:** 11:07 AM, Aug 3.

I also put the status-page access issue (INC-4821) in as an open item. Two things to check before you forward it. My draft says the incident room "was opened at 10:42," which is really the first message in the channel, so that wording may need changing. I also quoted "Rebot failed" as written in the ticket, which may be a typo for "Reboot."
